queries.name: Virtual call from constructor or destructor
queries.description: Virtual functions should not be invoked from a constructor or destructor of the same class. The call should be made explicitly static by qualifying it using the scope resolution operator.

queries.name: Resource not released in destructor

Best practice in C++ is to use the 'RAII' technique: constructors allocate resources and destructors free them.
